title: Better Item Breaking (BIB)
description: Make your Item unusable instead of disappear when breaking!
body:
How would it feel if you just make your **SUPER VERY RARE TOOLS, WEAPONS and ARMOR** break and it just disappear? Well THIS mod will fix that!

When your item's durability reaches **breaking point,** it becomes **unbreakable.** Your item won't disappear anymore!

**BUT...**

Once it reaches the breaking point, the item becomes effectively **broken**:

- No enchantments working
- No attribute bonuses
- No armor protection
- No useful functionality

You can still hold or wear it, but it will do **absolutely nothing.**

And if it hit breaking point even mending can't help you. you'll have to repair it yourself.

This mod will show which item are broken in your Main Hand, Off Hand, Armor Slots (can be turn off)
![Ex. for broken notifier](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c001d5449d6dee692d6887dc0f7d4257dd820549.png)
**If you want me to make this mod for other versions or other modloader pls tell me in my Discord server**

Compatible with most mods.
Some heavily customized enchantment and durability systems may require compatibility updates.


```
**[Compatibility]** 
- Epic Fight (only attributes) (BIB 2)
```
